title: Brand profile
description: Rules for brand_validation.py. Uploaded to DIAL file storage under the file name in BRAND_PROFILE_FILE, and attached to a deck with attach_brand_profile; never committed with real brand values — the repo ships this schema and brand_profile.example.json only. All lengths in inches, all colours as [r, g, b].

name.description: Brand name, echoed in reports so the agent can name what it is being held to.

severity.description: Default severity for every finding (default: warning). Export never blocks on a warning.

fonts.description: Typefaces the brand allows. Only explicitly-set fonts are checked; text that inherits the template's font is by definition on-brand.

allowed.description: Case-insensitive font names. Empty or absent disables the check.

min_font_pt.description: Smallest point size any visible text may use.

min_font_exempt_idx.description: Placeholder idx values exempt from the size floor — the template's own fine print, e.g. a source line or a page number.

palette_rgb.description: Every colour the brand allows. Theme colours are never checked against this: they come from the brand's own template.

palette_tolerance.description: Per-channel slack when matching a colour to the palette.

families.description: Rules that differ by background family. A slide is 'dark' when its background luminance is below 0.5, 'light' otherwise.

chrome_idx.description: Placeholder idx values the template places outside the safe area on purpose (logo, page number, source line), and which are therefore not reported for crossing it.

chrome_shapes.description: How to recognise each piece of required chrome. Keys are the names used in families.*.require.

require_alpha_on_fills.description: Report a picture with an opaque background placed on a coloured slide — the flattened-icon defect.

max_consecutive_same_family.description: Longest run of slides allowed on one background family before the deck is reported as monotonous.

exempt_layouts.description: Layout names (case-insensitive) whose slides are not checked for required chrome — typically the title and closing layouts.

review_notes.description: Rules that cannot be made deterministic. Joined and passed to the vision reviewer as its extra focus, so they are enforced by the model rather than by this module.

safe_area_in.description: The frame content must stay inside — well inside the slide edge, which is all deck_validation checks.

require.description: Names from chrome_shapes that every slide of this family must carry.

chromeShape.description: A placeholder is looked for on the slide itself (an inherited placeholder renders nothing until the slide carries its own copy); a line or a picture is looked for on the slide, its layout and its master, because those do render by inheritance.

idx.description: placeholder: the placeholder idx to look for.

aspect_ratios.description: picture: acceptable width/height ratios — one per approved variant of the mark.

y_in.description: line: where the rule sits from the top of the slide.

max_height.description: line: how thick a shape may be and still count as a rule.
